content.introduction: The latest technology news from Yahoo Finance includes updates on the AI boom, with a focus on a key metric, and mentions of Anthropic launching Opus 5.5. Additionally, there are financial market updates, including the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq selling off due to inflation worries, and the 10-year Treasury yield reaching its highest level since 2007. On Yahoo Tech, there are mentions of new developments in AI, including a new plan for ChatGPT costing $500 a month and the launch of GPT-6.1 Sol by OpenAI, which claims to nearly match GPT-6 Astra at a lower cost.
